observations: Photo 0 is a very dark shot of the rear and side of a black television standing on a terrazzo floor.
The deep, bulging rear housing with vent slots shows it is an old tube (CRT) television, not a flat panel.
No screen, front bezel, logo or rating label is visible, so the brand and model cannot be read.
Power cable visible running over the back housing; no sign of the set being switched on.
The set looks large for a CRT, but there is nothing in frame to measure the screen size against.
Other dark objects, possibly speakers, are at the left edge.

claims.evidence: No logo or rear label is visible in photo 0.
Screen not shown and no scale reference; a front photo with a tape measure across the diagonal would settle it.
No power-on attempt shown; the seller's own admission of a fault is accepted and the set is priced as not working.

risks.risk: Fault is worse than a blown transformer (tube, board or flyback damage), so it is only scrap.
risks.proof: Clip of the set plugged in and switched on, showing what happens.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a dead CRT for parts or scrap.

risks.risk: Screen glass cracked or tube damaged; front never shown.
risks.proof: Clear daylight photo of the front and screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged tube, scrap value only.

risks.risk: Back cover, parts or the main board already removed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear label and of all sides in good light.

risks.risk: Screen size smaller than the claimed 29 inch.
risks.proof: Front photo with a tape measure across the screen diagonal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller CRT set.

proof_requests: Daylight photo of the front showing the screen and the brand logo.
Close photo of the rear rating label with brand and model.
Front photo with a tape measure across the screen diagonal.
Clip of the set plugged in and switched on.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows an old CRT television and the seller says it does not work, so its worst case is a faulty set for parts, which can be priced now. Brand and size are not readable, so it is priced as an unbranded, not working CRT set until proven.
